summary: Optional OpenAlex API key. New app/openalex_key.py stores it in its own 0600 file (environment variable wins), never in settings.json and never echoed; OpenAlex._request sends it only as an Authorization bearer header, unredirected, to https://api.openalex.org, so it cannot appear in URLs, cache keys or errors; /api/settings gains openalex_key, clear_openalex_key and a status field; settings page gains the field and a clear button; tools/data_probe.py reads OPENALEX_API_KEY. Registers OPENALEX-AUTH.
scope_note: On top of a49a573. The untracked .claude/settings.json and .claude/worktrees/ are the owner's and not part of this unit. The real key was pasted by the owner in chat and is not in any file of this unit.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call and no model operation or ceiling changed. A key may raise the OpenAlex daily request allowance; the allowance and cost per request are provider facts, not measured here.
budget_impact.before: Anonymous OpenAlex use only (observed 1000 credits / $0.10 per day).
budget_impact.after: Optional key sent as a header to api.openalex.org; allowance with a key unmeasured.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; secret handling and request construction only

open_risks: The key was pasted in chat and sits in the session transcript; rotate it in the OpenAlex account if that matters.
The settings page change was not exercised in a running app.
The key file is plain text under the data directory (0600), the same trust level as the existing DeepSeek key file.

Measured live: Bearer header accepted, wrong key rejected with 401, allowance 10000 credits / $1 per day with the key versus 1000 / $0.10 without. Whether mailto still matters with a key is undetermined.
